definitions.name: Metamagic: Seeking Spell
definitions.summary: 2 sorcery points: reroll the d20 of a spell attack you missed and use the new roll; works alongside another Metamagic option.

actions.name: Seeking Spell
actions.note: After missing with a spell attack: reroll the d20 and use the new roll. Can be combined with another Metamagic option.

definitions.name: Metamagic: Transmuted Spell
definitions.summary: 1 sorcery point: a spell dealing acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder damage deals another of those types instead. Pick the new type when you roll its damage.

actions.name: Transmuted Spell
actions.note: Pick the new damage type in the spell's damage roll: the point is spent when you roll.
